output.title: Signature algorithm customization available in v1.18.0
output.content: This environment actively uses cert-manager with Certificate resources (cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate apiVersion is in use). The feature adds signature algorithm customization—a core cert-manager capability. The release notes excerpt does not detail which resources or fields are affected by this customization. Inspect your Certificate, Issuer, and ClusterIssuer definitions and check the v1.18.0 release notes for which fields now support custom signature algorithm configuration.
